0.title: Global Action Required Components
0.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | summarize runtime_issue = countIf(source_status != "current"), by: { component } | join [ load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter is_latest == "true" | summarize upgrade_issue = countIf(is_newer_than_running == "true"), by: { component } ], on: { component } | fieldsAdd upgrade_issue = right.upgrade_issue | summarize action_required = countIf(runtime_issue > 0 or upgrade_issue > 0)

2.title: SaaS Runtime Source Health
2.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | filter component == "saas" | summarize rows = count(), by: { source_status, source_type, observed_version } | fieldsAdd status_badge = if(source_status == "current", "current", else: if(source_status == "partial", "partial", else: if(source_status == "not_configured", "not configured", else: "unavailable"))) | sort source_status asc, source_type asc

3.title: SaaS Release Status
3.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter component == "saas" | fields released_version, release_status, is_latest, is_next_planned, running_version, release_url, fetched_at | sort is_latest desc, released_version desc

4.title: SaaS Upgrade Queue
4.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter component == "saas" and is_latest == "true" and released_version != "" and released_version != "Not yet published" | fields running_version, latest_published = released_version, is_newer_than_running, release_url, fetched_at | fieldsAdd action = if(is_newer_than_running == "true", "newer available", else: if(running_version == "" or running_version == "-", "runtime unknown", else: "aligned")), action_priority = if(is_newer_than_running == "true", 1, else: if(running_version == "" or running_version == "-", 2, else: 3)) | sort action_priority asc | fields running_version, latest_published, action, release_url, fetched_at

5.title: SaaS Risk and Highlights
5.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter component == "saas" and is_latest == "true" | fields released_version, risk = if(breaking_changes_summary == "" or breaking_changes_summary == "-", "No breaking changes extracted", else: breaking_changes_summary), highlights = if(highlights_summary == "" or highlights_summary == "-", "No highlights extracted", else: highlights_summary), release_url, fetched_at
